applies_to: Parents or legal guardians of a newborn child.
office: सम्बन्धित वडा कार्यालय (Local Ward Office) or local registrar
practical_tip: Always call the specific ward office before visiting to confirm if they require additional local documents (like a vaccination card or neighbor verification) and to check their exact late fee (बिलम्ब शुल्क) structure.

steps.action: Fill the personal event registration information form.
Submit the form with required documents to the local registrar.
Verification and issuance of the birth registration certificate.

documents.name: Copy of father's or mother's Nepali citizenship certificate
Copy of informant's (सूचक) citizenship certificate
documents.reason: Informant must be an authorized and identifiable person

documents.name: Birth report from health institution/hospital OR vaccination card (if born at home)
documents.reason: To verify date and place of birth

variants.case: Single mother or father's address unknown

extra_or_different_documents: Birth certificate attested by Nepali Embassy

fee: Free if registered within 35 days. Late registration incurs a delayed fee (बिलम्ब शुल्क) as per local municipal rules.
time_needed: Same day if procedure and documents are complete.
legal_basis: जन्म, मृत्यु तथा अन्य व्यक्तिगत घटना (दर्ता गर्ने) ऐन, २०३३ and नियमावली, २०७१
flags: Late fee amounts vary by municipality and are not uniformly specified in national FAQs.

applies_to: Individuals born to Nepali citizen parents before the commencement of the Constitution.
office: जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय (District Administration Office - DAO)
online_note: Ward recommendation can sometimes be initiated online, but final submission and biometric/verification steps are strictly in person.
practical_tip: Always consult designated personnel at the DAO or your ward office before visiting to confirm if a field verification (सर्जमिन) is required for your specific case, as this significantly impacts processing time.

steps.action: Obtain citizenship recommendation from the permanent address Ward Office.
Submit application with documents and Rs. 10 revenue stamp at DAO.
Verification and issuance of citizenship certificate.

documents.name: Schedule-1 (अनुसूची-१) application form with Ward recommendation
Birth registration certificate
documents.reason: To verify date and place of birth

documents.name: Father's and Mother's Nepali citizenship certificates

fee: Rs. 10 (Revenue stamp / हुलाक टिकट) at DAO. Ward recommendation fees vary (typically Rs. 100-300).
time_needed: Same day if all documents are complete and verified; longer if field verification (सर्जमिन) is triggered.
legal_basis: नेपाल नागरिकता ऐन, २०६३ and नागरिकता नियमावली, २०६३

sources.title: नेपाली नागरिकताको प्रकार र बनाउने प्रक्रिया

flags: Some DAOs may request additional local verification (सर्जमिन) if documents are disputed, which extends the time needed.

applies_to: Nepali citizens, including minors (with guardian presence).
office: राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र तथा पञ्जीकरण विभाग (Department of National ID and Civil Registration) or designated enrollment centers
online_note: Pre-enrollment is done at citizenportal.donidcr.gov.np. Crucial: Fill *every* field, including grandparents' address (even if deceased), to avoid system validation errors. If the appointment calendar does not allow date selection, choose 'Others' or leave blank. If a specific date is assigned, you must visit *only* on that date.
practical_tip: Always call or consult designated personnel at the enrollment center before visiting to confirm document requirements and appointment validity, as walk-ins are often rejected without a valid appointment.

steps.action: Pre-register online, filling all mandatory fields completely.
Provide biometric data (photograph, fingerprints, iris scan) on the scheduled date.
Receive acknowledgment slip with a tracking number.
Collect the National ID card when notified via SMS.

documents.name: Original Nepali citizenship certificate
documents.reason: Primary proof of nationality and identity

documents.name: Birth registration certificate
documents.reason: May be required for minors or if citizenship lacks birth details

extra_or_different_documents: Guardian's physical presence during biometric capture

time_needed: Biometric capture takes 15-30 minutes. Card delivery time varies (weeks to months) and is not officially guaranteed.
legal_basis: राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र तथा पञ्जीकरण ऐन, २०७६ and नियमावली, २०७७
flags: Online form validation can be strict regarding ancestral address fields; leaving them blank may prevent submission.
Card delivery timelines depend on printing batch schedules and are not guaranteed in days/weeks.

applies_to: Individuals applying for Nepali citizenship who need local verification.
office: सम्बन्धित वडा कार्यालय (Ward Office of permanent address)
practical_tip: Always call the ward office before visiting to confirm if they require a field verification (सर्जमिन), the exact fee for your municipality, and if any additional local documents (like a landlord's letter) are needed.

steps.action: Submit the filled citizenship recommendation application form with required documents.
Ward office verification (may include field visit / सर्जमिन if deemed necessary).
Issuance of the citizenship recommendation letter.

documents.name: Copy of father's or mother's Nepali citizenship certificate
documents.reason: To establish descent for the recommendation

documents.name: Applicant's birth registration certificate
documents.reason: To verify date and place of birth

extra_or_different_documents: Proof of foreign citizenship renunciation (if applicable)

time_needed: Same day if documents are complete; up to 3 days if field verification (सर्जमिन) is required.
flags: Fee and exact processing time vary significantly between different municipalities and wards. The fee range is based on sampled citizen charters.

applies_to: Nepali citizens applying for a new passport or renewal requiring local address verification.
office: सम्बन्धित वडा कार्यालय (Ward Office of permanent address)
online_note: Applicants are often advised to fill the online passport application form at the Department of Passport website before visiting the ward for the recommendation.
practical_tip: Always consult designated personnel at the ward office before visiting to confirm if a recommendation is still required for your specific case (e.g., some renewals may bypass this). Note: The Rs. 5,000 (regular) or Rs. 10,000+ (urgent) fee is charged by the Department of Passport/DAO for issuance, NOT by the ward for the recommendation (which is nominal).

steps.action: Fill the passport recommendation form (and online passport application if applicable).
Submit the form with required documents to the Ward Office.
Ward verification and issuance of the recommendation letter.

documents.name: Original Nepali citizenship certificate and photocopy
Recent passport-size photos (3 copies)
documents.reason: For ward records and recommendation letter

extra_or_different_documents: Rs. 10 revenue stamp for urgent request at DAO
Note: Urgent passport issuance fee at DAO/Passport Dept is Rs. 10,000 (or up to Rs. 15,000 in some cases), while regular is Rs. 5,000. The ward recommendation fee remains nominal.

fee: Rs. 100 - 200 (Ward recommendation fee). Passport issuance fee is Rs. 5,000 (regular) or Rs. 10,000+ (urgent) at the Department of Passport/DAO.
time_needed: Same day at ward office if documents are complete.

sources.title: स्वत: प्रकाशन - ईलाका प्रशासन कार्यालय चैनपुर
सेवा पुस्तिका - जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय, कास्की

flags: Some DAOs now accept direct online applications without ward recommendation for certain renewals, but first-time applicants generally still require it. Verify with the specific DAO.
The high cost (Rs. 5,000-10,000+) is strictly the passport issuance fee at the central level, not the local ward recommendation fee.
